title: Ox Passion Pina Daiquiri Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Salts Pina Daiquiri brings together the smooth, creamy sweetness of Pineapple with a bright splash of zesty Lime. The tropical pineapple takes centre stage, offering a juicy and slightly tangy inhale, while the lime adds a vibrant citrus kick that lingers on the exhale, creating an endlessly refreshing and well-balanced fruit blend. Blended in a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, ensuring a smooth throat hit and full-bodied flavour. Perfect for pod vape kits and starter devices, it delivers rapid nicotine absorption for a consistently satisfying vape experience. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping technology, the OX Passion Salts range features expertly crafted flavours designed to pair seamlessly with Oxva’s XLIM pod kits and other refillable vape devices.
